ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AND EASEMENT AGREEMENT (this "Agreement") is made as of the 13 day of August, 2019 by 458 NY LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, having an address at c/o Extell Development Company, 805 Third Avenue, 7th Floor, New York, New York 10022, in its capacity as the owner of Lot 9, as hereinafter defined ("Extell Owner"), and in its capacity as owner of the Developer Land, as hereinafter defined ("Developer"). STATEMENTOFFACTS Extell Owner is the current owner in fee of certain land in the County ofNewYork, City and State of New York, generally known by the street address West45thStreet,New York, New York, designated as Lot 9 in Block 1017 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, hereto (said land being herein called "Lot 9"). Developer is the owner in fee of certain land in the County of New York, City and State of New York, generally known by the street address 251 West 45th Street, New York, New York, designated as Lot 7 in Block 1017 on the Tax Map and more particularly described on    a,    a      buildings and improvements thereon permitted in accordance with this Agreement, being herein collectively called the “Developer Building:*' and the Developer Land and the Developer Building being herein collectively called the “Developer Premises"). Extell Owner intends to convey Lot-9 to 267-269 West 45th Street, L.L.C. (*"Shubert Owner") pursuant to that certain Bargain and Sale Deed dated as of the date hereof and intended to be recorded after this Agreement (the “Lot 9 Deed"), with the intention that such conveyance of Lot 9 shall (x) exclude the Subject Floor Area Development Rights (as hereinafter defined), and (y) be subject to this Agreement.  ( ro r n x s e    d  p a n continue to constitute a single zoning lot (as defined in the Zoning Resolution, as hereinafter defined), and by execution of a Confirmatory Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions of even date and contemporaneously with the Lot 9 Deed (the “Declaration"), Shubert Owner and Developer intend to utilize the procedure available under Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution to confirm that Lot 9 and the Developer Land continue to be a single zoning lot (such zoning lot, as the same may be enlarged or subdivided in accordance with this Agreement, the "Combined Zoning Lot"). Each of Developer and Shubert Owner (by taking its interest in Lot 9 subject to this Agreement) may, in accordance with the provisions of this Agreement, (A) acquire and/or, by incorporation into the Combined Zoning Lot, utilize certain Additional Parcels (as hereinafter defined), and (B) merge the Combined Zoning Lot with certain Additional Parcels acquired by Developer or Owmer, as applicable, to create an enlarged Coimbined Zoning.
